title: Ege-Balancer — Faults
description: A fault followed from the backend to the client: what the mock backends did, what the balancer counted, and what clients received.

list.name: Reload rejected
list.textFormat: the file was invalid; the running configuration was kept

list.name: window
list.label: Window
list.description: How far back each rate and average looks. Longer windows smooth out noise.

panels.title: Faults in force
panels.description: Faults injected through the mock backends' admin ports that have not yet expired or been cleared. Background rates set by a profile are not counted.

panels.title: Failed attempts
panels.description: Attempts the balancer counted against a backend, for any reason.

panels.title: Retries
panels.description: Requests the balancer sent to another backend after a failed attempt.

panels.title: Answers cut off
panels.description: Answers a backend broke off part way. The client's connection is closed before the whole answer arrives, often before any of it when the part sent fits in the balancer's buffer. Nothing can retry an answer already on its way.

panels.title: Errors reaching clients
panels.description: 5xx answers from the backends, and 503s from the balancer when no backend served the request, a request could not safely be retried, or the retry budget was spent.

panels.title: Injected faults
panels.description: The fault injected into each mock backend, from the demo console's 8 or by hand, for as long as it was in force. A backend with two at once shows the later one in this list: hang, reset, drip, error, slow, freeze.

targets.expr: max by (name) (label_replace(mock_fault_in_force{backend=~"$backend", mode="hang"}, "name", "$1", "backend", "([^:]+).*") * 1 or label_replace(mock_fault_in_force{backend=~"$backend", mode="reset"}, "name", "$1", "backend", "([^:]+).*") * 2 or label_replace(mock_fault_in_force{backend=~"$backend", mode="drip"}, "name", "$1", "backend", "([^:]+).*") * 3 or label_replace(mock_fault_in_force{backend=~"$backend", mode="error"}, "name", "$1", "backend", "([^:]+).*") * 4 or label_replace(mock_fault_in_force{backend=~"$backend", mode="slow"}, "name", "$1", "backend", "([^:]+).*") * 5 or label_replace(mock_fault_in_force{backend=~"$backend", mode="freeze"}, "name", "$1", "backend", "([^:]+).*") * 6)

panels.title: Mock backends reachable
panels.description: Mock backends whose admin port Prometheus can reach. A frozen backend is still reachable; a stopped container is not.

panels.title: Requests not answered normally, by outcome
panels.description: What the mock backends did instead of answering normally: hung, dropped the connection part way (reset), dripped the answer out, answered 500 (error), refused with a full queue (overloaded). Abandoned requests are the ones the balancer gave up on first, at its response timeout or because its client left.

panels.title: Requests not answered normally, by backend
panels.description: The same requests, by the backend that did it. Each backend keeps its profile's colour.

panels.title: Workers busy
panels.description: Share of each backend's workers serving a request, averaged over the window. Hanging requests hold theirs until the balancer gives up on them.

panels.title: Queued for a worker
panels.description: Requests waiting for a worker, averaged over the window. Beyond its queue a backend refuses with 503.

panels.title: Cold start
panels.description: How many times slower than normal each backend is while it warms up after starting; 1 once warm. Only the realistic overlay starts backends cold.

panels.title: Failed attempts by reason
panels.description: Why the balancer counted an attempt against a backend: no connection (connect), no answer within the response timeout (timeout), the connection closed before the answer (reset), the answer broken off part way (cut_off), or a 5xx under retry_on_5xx. A client that gives up is not counted.

panels.title: Failed attempts, last 5 minutes
panels.description: Failed attempts by backend and reason over the last five minutes.

panels.title: Backend health
panels.description: Green while health checking keeps a backend in the pool, red while it is out.

panels.title: Retries, and requests not retried
panels.description: Retries the balancer sent, and failed requests it did not retry: a POST or PATCH a backend may already have carried out, or a retry the budget refused.

panels.title: Answers to clients
panels.description: Everything clients received: answers from the backends by status class, the balancer's own 503s, and answers cut off part way. The axis is logarithmic, so that a few failures a second show next to the answers that succeeded. Clients that gave up are not here.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Time the answering attempt took, measured at the balancer. A drip or a slow fault shows here rather than as a failure. Time spent on failed attempts before it is not included: a hang the balancer gave up on and retried elsewhere shows as a retry, not here.

panels.title: Cache hit rate by backend
panels.description: Share of requests naming a session that the backend remembered. A miss costs the backend more time. Only the realistic overlay gives backends a memory.

defaults.noValue: No sessions: requests need an X-Session header, as loadgen -keys sends

panels.title: Sessions remembered
panels.description: Sessions each backend remembers. A backend that restarts, or whose cache is cleared, starts again from none.
